basis: The App Store privacy label for this app and the app's App Store description. Draft prepared 10 November 2026; awaiting the developer's confirmation.
summary: Voice Clock has no ad identifiers. Your recordings, photos, schedules and settings stay on your device and sync only through your own private iCloud.
onDevice: Your voice recordings and imported audio
Background photos you choose (copied into the app; they never leave your device)
Schedules, the Delivery Log and settings

permissions.name: Microphone
permissions.why: Only when you record your own announcement.

permissions.name: Photos or Camera
permissions.why: Only when you choose a background photo.

permissions.name: Notifications
permissions.why: To deliver announcements and the five-minute heads-up.

permissions.name: Personal Voice
permissions.why: Only if you choose to use your Personal Voice for announcements.

purchases: Pro is sold through the App Store. Apple handles payment.
